global_events: Brent crude has climbed above $95 a barrel, hitting rupee and bond sentiment, while US tech looks soft, with Alphabet sliding and SanDisk falling even after strong profits. Washington is threatening higher tariffs to push partners into trade deals, and France faces recession risk. On the positive side, US consumer confidence jumped after the midterm results, though inflation worries persist.
central_banks: The Fed's favoured inflation gauge rose to 3.8% in October, raising the stakes for policy in 2027, and some commentary argues the incoming Fed leadership may need to tighten. In India, the RBI has flagged food inflation risks, and Indian government bonds fell sharply as crude rose, so a hawkish tilt in yields is likely to weigh on rate-sensitive sectors.
policy_sentiment: Trump is reportedly targeting India's Make in India and PLI schemes, and Indian traders are urging a 25% retaliatory duty, a trade-friction risk for export and PLI-linked names. India has also told Netflix not to stream Pakistani content.

research.why: Nature Nanotechnology demonstration of a hybrid core combining VO2 Mott leaky integrate-and-fire neurons with domain-wall racetrack memory for event-driven spiking networks, linking spintronic memory to neuromorphic computing.
research.title: Integration of Mott neurons and spintronic memories for event-driven spiking neural networks

research.why: Nature paper showing coherent time-resolved parity oscillations among four poor man's Majoranas in two coupled minimal Kitaev chains, a step toward topologically protected qubits.
research.title: Coherent parity oscillations in coupled minimal Kitaev chains

research.why: Nature Physics demonstration of two-qubit gates between strongly coupled electron qubits on solid neon, advancing a promising new qubit platform.

research.why: PRL protocol for high-purity magnon-mediated spin entanglement that avoids the usual coupling-versus-decay trade-off by coupling magnons only to a transition outside the computational basis.
